name: notewright
description: Compose, arrange and mix songs with the com.graze.music engine (playback V3) and export WAV, stems, MIDI, MusicXML/PDF score and Unity song folders. Finds instruments automatically (built-in synths, VSCO 2 CE orchestral samples) or uses SFZ/WAV instruments on your computer; on Windows x64 also installed VST3 instruments and effects.
